craftsmanSpirit.name: Craftsman Spirit
craftsmanSpirit.description: Daily tokens = 0 while salary, city, model, and multiplier are all valid. You are refining the workflow before deciding to spend tokens.

promptAlchemist.name: Prompt Alchemist
promptAlchemist.description: Performance multiplier >= 6 and 0 < daily tokens <= 20. You are squeezing serious leverage out of a still-disciplined token budget.

allInOperator.name: All-In Operator
allInOperator.description: Daily tokens >= 150 and performance multiplier >= 3. This is the signature of a high-intensity, high-spend Agent workflow.

minimalistRunner.name: Minimalist Runner
minimalistRunner.description: 0 < daily tokens <= 5 and performance multiplier >= 2. You keep the workflow useful even under an almost tiny token budget.

costTamer.name: Cost Tamer
costTamer.description: Cost effectiveness >= 2.5 while AI cost share stays <= 15%. You found a notably clean balance between spend and payoff.

dangerOracle.name: Danger Oracle
dangerOracle.description: Effective people equivalent >= 2.5, or the danger scale has already entered high risk. You are staring at the real pressure of a multiplied coworker.

budgetCoordinator.name: Budget Coordinator
budgetCoordinator.description: The current budget can sustain >= 8 equivalent workflows. This setup is not only viable, it is also easy to scale.

overlay.title: New title unlocked
overlay.description: There is no always-on title panel anymore. When a title is earned for the first time, it gets one full-screen reveal and then the page returns to normal.
overlay.footer: The reveal only happens on first acquisition. Reaching the same condition again will not replay it.

hagicode.heading: What if Hagicode amplified your efficiency?
hagicode.subtitle: Hagicode can drive multiple agents in parallel, turning proposal, implementation, fixes and review from serial waits into parallel progress. Adjust the slider below and we immediately recompute coworker threat and AI value under this revised model.
hagicode.sliderHint: Slide between 1.5 and 10 to set how many parallel sessions Hagicode manages simultaneously. More parallel sessions means greater subjective efficiency amplification.
hagicode.utilizationHint: Slide between 1.1 and 2.0. Higher utilization means OpenSpec reduces rework, misuse, and hallucination, so actual token spend gets diluted under the same target output.
hagicode.modelFormula: New token spend = base {{base}} x Hagicode {{boost}} ÷ token utilization {{utilization}} = {{final}}. In other words, it first expands to {{raw}}, then standardized workflow efficiency pulls effective spend back down to {{final}}.
hagicode.detailCollapseAria: Expand to view detailed efficiency, token, and cost comparison data

footer.disclaimer: This page helps illustrate how Agent workflows amplify individual output. The real risk is not AI alone, but colleagues who already use it as a repeatable system.
footer.extensionNote: The model prices, formulas, and conclusions on this page are for understanding Agent workflow cost and leverage only, not investment, hiring, or career advice.
